sentences.en: It will churn out only goodness in the long run.
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，它只会产生良好的结果。

sentences.en: I did that out of the goodness of my heart.
sentences.zh: 我完全是出于好意这么做的。

sentences.en: For goodness sake, don't speak to the boss like that!
sentences.zh: 哎呀，别那样跟老板说话！

senses.zh: 善良，美德；仁慈，慷慨；精华，养分
（表示吃惊或愤怒）天哪；上帝的替代语
